thread.title: Kuo leaks more on Apple Inc (AAPL)’s 2018 iPhones, to be well-selling devices

author: James Conlon
title: Kuo leaks more on Apple Inc (AAPL)’s 2018 iPhones, to be well-selling devices
text:
January 29, 2018 Kuo leaks more on Apple Inc (AAPL)’s 2018 iPhones, to be well-selling devices 
Apple Inc. (AAPL) is committed to introduce three latest iPhones in 2018 so it is going to be an exciting year for iPhone advancements. The first is going to be a second-generation version of the iPhone X, with the identical 5.8-inch OLED display, while the second an “iPhone X Plus” will appear with a larger 6.5 inch OLED display. 
Besides these two OLED iPhones that would certainly be just as expensive as the current iPhone X, the company is planning to unveil a new, more reasonably priced 6.1-inch iPhone having an LCD display. This device could probably use a Full Active LCD display that will offer better technology over the iPhone 8 and 8 Plus display. 
Today, Ming-Chi Kuo, KGI Securities analyst shared a trio of new research notes that highlight both new and existing predictions regarding the new iPhone X, iPhone X Plus, and more affordable 6.1-inch iPhone expected by the end of this year. 
The research note suggests that Taiwanese manufacturers Foxconn, Pegatron and Wistron would be the main assemblers of the 6.1-inch iPhone, 30 percent, with 60 percent and 10 percent allocation of EMS respectively. 
Japan Display would supply about 70 percent of LCD panels for the 6.1 inch iPhone. Rumors suggest the company will embed Japan Display’s six inch Full Active LCDs that only need ultra-slim 0.5mm bezels around all four sides. 
The rumored 6.1-inch iPhone will take nearly full screen design without home button along with notch for TrueDepth sensors. The device will have 3D sensing for Face ID and Animoji. It will incorporate a rectangular-shaped, one-cell battery with 2,850-2,950 mAh, that is about 8.5 percent bigger than current iPhone X. The enlarged capacity will be the outcome of a smaller logic board given manufacturing advancements. That iPhone will be priced between $700 and $800 in US. Kuo previously said the device will involve an aluminum frame, a single rather than dual lens rear camera, a lack of 3D Touch and 3GB of RAM, which would be less memory compared to other latest 2018 iPhones. 
According to Kuo, the larger iPhone X Plus and second-generation iPhone X will each have an increased 4GB of RAM. Unsurprisingly, the iPhone X Plus is also anticipated to have a 25 percent larger battery capacity of 3,300-3,400 mAh. Kuo added that both iPhones will have a two-cell, L-shaped battery. Kuo does not anticipate much improvements to be made to the TrueDepth camera system till 2019. However, he expects the devices to sell well, particularly the less expensive 6.1-inch iPhone.
